Current Work Featured projects Current Perturbative String Cosmology A publication-linked research theme spanning perturbative moduli stabilisation, Kähler-modulus inflation and fibre-inflation scenarios. Lead: Ahmed Rakin Kamal, Mishaal Hai, Sayeda Tashnuba Jahan and collaborators Current Higher-Derivative String Theory and Dualities Higher-derivative corrections, M-theory/type-II reductions and duality constraints in string effective actions. Lead: Ahmed Rakin Kamal and collaborators Current Time Dependent Backgrounds in String Theory and Early Universe Cosmology Time-dependent internal geometry, flux backgrounds and cosmological solutions in higher-dimensional supergravity and early-universe theory.
